hooks.command: CHANGED="$TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH"; [[ "$CHANGED" == */themes/*.css ]] && { REQUIRED='--bg --primary --secondary --muted --border --card-dark --card-light --green --red --font-display --font-heading --font-body --logo --w --h --pad'; MISSING=''; for token in $REQUIRED; do grep -q -- "$token" "$CHANGED" || MISSING="$MISSING $token"; done; [ -n "$MISSING" ] && echo "⚠️ $(basename "$CHANGED") 缺少 token:$MISSING" || exit 0; } || exit 0
FILE="$TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH"; case "$FILE" in */_template/*|*/base.css) echo '⛔ 這是系統模板檔案，請複製到 contents/ 再編輯'; exit 2;; esac
